why: Treats a reading with no sideways result as a clean one. This is the defect that let a sideways-overflowing pane ship: `overflow.page` could never fire, and a check that cannot fire is indistinguishable from a check that found nothing. Without the guard, a `page.evaluate` that returned undefined -- or a collector that stopped reporting -- would restore exactly that blind spot while every required check stayed green.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) fails a reading with no sideways result at all, instead of passing it
